title: THE LONG WAY BACK · XV · The empty stool
venue: the sabbatical · never posted · found in Box 9
logline: Stop fifteen: a bar in a town without a name, one stool empty at the end with a coaster on it and a drink nobody ordered, the bartender not looking at the stool, and a lean man at the far end who is looking at the traveler. The card: a figure with two smaller ones chained loosely below. The traveler leaves the drink.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a bar interior, low light, one empty stool at the end with a full glass on a coaster before it, the bartender turned away.
